newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: BT, NTT in Singapore telecom bid.
newsitem.headline: BT, NTT in Singapore telecom bid.

text.p: British Telecom and Japan's Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) have joined a Singapore consortium to bid for the island-state's second basic telecommunications services license.
The other members of the consortium include Singapore Technologies Telemedia and Singapore Power, a joint statement from the companies said.
The license will be awarded in 1998.
The Singapore government had earlier said it would allow at least one and possibly two new operators to operate fixed line telephone services.
Currently, Singapore Telecom has a monopoly in providing fixed line services.
Another bidder for the second license was from a consortium led by Singapore Press Holdings.
Singapore Technologies Telemedia is a member of government-owned Singapore Technologies while Singapore Power is a utility and energy group.
